title: Compact field profiles
lead: Measures what makes `table.fields` large and shrinks it before the schema freeze. On wide files the field profiles are most of the descriptor: about 1.26 KB per field, 78% of a 300-column descriptor (sq-20 measurement, 2026-10-27). The evidence section is a near-constant ~3.6 KB and is not the driver.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goals: a stable schema and output that consumers can store and diff. Shape changes must land before the freeze (sq-12).

sq-20 (compact evidence) was retired: on main there is no per-field type evidence to group, so its spec made descriptors larger. Owner decision (2026-10-27), verbatim: "Retire, refile on fields (Recommended)" (option text: "Discard the evidence grouping (keep only the new nonNullFields pin test). Retire sq-20 with a note, and file a new pre-freeze slice: measure and shrink what drives table.fields size (null members, nameParts, number arrays on one line), with the target set from measurements."). The pin test was not needed: HintTests already pins nonNullFields as indexes.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
1. Measure first (no code change): on a 300-column synthetic file and the local real samples (aggregates only), break `table.fields` bytes down by member, including `null`-valued members, `nameParts`, shapes, quantiles, and indentation/whitespace. Report the table to the owner with candidate changes and their savings. The owner picks which to do before step 2.
2. Implement the chosen changes in `src/squalify/Json/DescriptorWriter.cs` (and the model only where a member is removed), with `docs/descriptor.md` and `docs/design.md` in the same change (draft schemaVersion policy).

Candidates to measure (not decisions): omit members whose value is `null` instead of writing `null`, versus keeping every key for a fixed shape; write short number arrays and small objects on one line; drop `nameParts` members that repeat `name` when no convention matched.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Set after step 1, from the owner's choice. At least: a size test on a generated 300-column file (bytes per field at or below the agreed target), and every golden re-recorded with the diff reviewed (only the chosen changes).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release` (also with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`)
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- `docs/how-it-works.md` updated and re-rendered if it describes the changed members.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-32` on branch `sq-32`. No agent commits.
